items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I think Sol (inaudible) made the arrangement -- I forget who made (inaudible).

ctx.x:
band.
I went and got most of his records, I familiarized myself with some of the hard things in his book that he had (inaudible).

"Walking By The River," that was a great thing by Una Mae Carlisle. He had a great arrangement on that.
I think Sol (inaudible) made the arrangement -- I forget who made (inaudible). But I know it was really a tough arrangement especially with the saxophone (inaudible) because it was a double-up chorus.
And they had a little bet on that that I couldn't play the book.
What do you mean a double-up chorus?
